title: [sweep] v18.3.0 release test sweep
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer asked in this session on 2026-10-29, verbatim: 「跟进平台 的 checklist ，和我沟通建议运行哪些测试，可以开云卡片」. On the proposed scope they chose 「完整发版前一轮」, a full release-candidate round, and added 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能处理 issue」.
Business reason: the next release ships through the Version Packages PR #26517. Its pending changesets are 300 in all: 164 minor, 0 major and 63 with `Clause-②: yes`. With the fixed group that makes 18.3.0. The checklist runs are the release's evidence that the standing smoke and the 18.x capabilities still hold at the release head, before the release merges.
Reader: the lane that owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Each checklist-accuracy line parked here is a ledger edit for that lane. The release decision reads the wave table in §0.
Dedupe (open AND closed): the query "[sweep] v18.3.0 release test sweep anchor" returned 15 hits and none of them is an 18.3 anchor. The nearest is #25807, the 18.2.0 anchor, which is still open for its parked partials.

This card is the **wave anchor** for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, called wave 3. RUNNER's extraction obligation (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`) applies:
- checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps, `partial` coverage gaps and not-run handovers close out **here**;
- product defects are extracted as their own cards and listed in §5;
- run records are `qa-run` issues that hang off this card by number.

## Why a full round, not a delta

- 514 commits on `main` since wave 2's subject `756220c4`.
- 162 runnable items changed `revision`, and 23 new Studio items landed through #26848.
- 254 runnable items cite a source file that changed.
- 20 QA-extracted fix cards closed after wave 2's subject, which is SKILL §5 trigger 2. Their retest list is §4 below. The 18.2.0 anchor's own §4 was never filled in.

A delta-only rerun saves little, so this is a release-candidate rerun (SKILL §5 trigger 1).

**Subject:** framework `main` @ `c4c515ad3cc342043a2b81b5a06a5793f79a23e8` (2026-10-29T03:33Z) for W3-C2a, W3-C2b, W3-C3a, W3-C3b and W3-UX. The Console is built in-repo from that same commit (`pnpm console:build`). None of these cards follows the Version PR as it regenerates.

**Re-pin, 2026-11-01:** triage 6553144940 found the `c4c515ad` evidence stale. The `priority:P0` set was re-run at `main` @ `eeec88d141cb2d303cb1b55b20b897c52ad86751` (2026-11-01T04:17Z) as W3-C1R, and its record #28545 supersedes W3-C1's #27481. The other cards' evidence stays at `c4c515ad`; their FAIL fixes have landed since, but those items were not re-judged (see §0.1).

_Body refreshed 2026-11-01T06:46Z by the dispatching PM session (triage 6553144940, items 2 and 3)._

Reading for the release decision:
- None of the 12 wave-3 FAILs is still an open card, except the #27482 parent, whose two arms have both merged.
- None of the 10 product-defect rows has been re-judged live since its fix. The fixes are carried on unit and e2e pins only. A targeted re-run of those 9 items at the release head would turn "fixed" into "re-judged".
- The one open FAIL at the newer head is #28546, a P0 regression.

The manual set follows the rule wave 2 used (#25817 / #26476 / #26456): the unpinned `since:v18.x` items, plus the unpinned P0/P1 items whose `source[]` cites a file changed by a commit carrying a `Clause-②: yes` changeset, plus the §4 retest items. Each card's dispatch lists its ids, 80 in all.

Not in this wave:
- the unpinned P2 items outside those rules (Tier 3);
- the post-publish npm smoke, which runs after 18.3.0 is published, against the registry.

Backend: one `mode:cloud` session per card, through `create_session` with `source_url`. The model tier is default (`dispatch-gates --tier` gives no path mandate). A QA run is not a lane card, so there is no lane claim (maintainer ruling recorded on #25807). Each card:
- files one `qa-run` record per selector under this anchor;
- extracts its product defects as their own cards;
- parks accuracy findings and gaps here.

## 1. Re-point — red rows this anchor owns

- `api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix` acceptance[0]: re-pointed by slice S6 (#28340).
- `records-forms.field-history-tracking` acceptance[2]: re-pointed by #27492.
- `studio-authoring.expression-editors`: not re-pointed. It is held as a product defect (§0.1 row 2).

## 2. Checklist-accuracy findings

- The wave-3 findings parked on this card at `c4c515ad` went through the census in 6539602007. They were edited into the ledger by slices S1–S8:
  - S1 #28352, S2 #28351 and S3 #28349;
  - S4–S8 #28338–#28342;
  - the five held items through #28345, landed as #28551.
- **Not yet in the ledger:** the 20 checklist-accuracy lines W3-C1R parked at `eeec88d1` (comment 6554042054).

- `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix`: NOT-RUN handover from #27441, still open.
- The other 23 wave-3 PARTIAL gaps stay as parked in the record comments. The census GAP rows (44) are listed in 6539602007.
